== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]], peeled and halved lengthwise
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Maple Syrup|maple syrup]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] dark [[Cookbook:Rum|rum]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] ground [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]

== Procedure ==
#Spray bananas and cold [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] grate with nonstick [[Cookbook:Cooking Spray|cooking spray]].
#Place a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over high heat and add rum. Ignite. Once flames have died, remove from heat and [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] in remaining ingredients.
#Place bananas cut side down on the preheated grill, and brush with rum mixture. Cook for 2 minutes, then flip and brush grilled side with more rum mixture. 
#Cook other side until well browned. Flip and cook just until browned. Remove and serve.
